scope.description: One exact published Logistik Unicorp organization refresh covering current contract activity, managed clothing programs, a partner-defined armour capability and bounded R&D evidence.

source.title: About Us - Logistik Unicorp
source.locator: Where We Started and company timeline
source.summary: Logistik states that Louis Bibeau founded the business as Unicorp Uniforms in 1993 and provides a dated corporate milestone history.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official corporate reporting, CanadaBuys and DND contract records, Open Government contributions, NP Aerospace system definition and ownership corroboration
followUpQuestions: What equipment, quantity or service scope did amendment 004 add to DICE contract CW2397900, and what has been delivered or accepted?
How are carrier, soft-armour and hard-plate responsibilities divided in the Women's Armour System, and has the complete system entered a named procurement or fielding program?
Which OCFC2 items are manufactured by Logistik, made by Canadian suppliers or sourced commercially, and which ordering and delivery functions does Logistik operate?
What technical functions were demonstrated under NRC IRAP agreement 1038022, and what maturity or follow-on work exists after the June 2026 end date?
reviewWarnings: CanadaBuys does not disclose what equipment, quantity or service amendment 004 adds, and no reviewed official source confirms DICE delivery, acceptance or fielding.
NP Aerospace calls the joint Women's Armour System field-ready, but no reviewed durable source identifies a buyer, contract, delivery, acceptance or in-service deployment for the complete system.
Logistik reports a hybrid factory, supplier and commercial sourcing model; public sources do not identify the manufacturer of every item delivered under its managed programs.
Wynnchurch still lists Logistik as a portfolio company, but current equity percentages and ultimate beneficial ownership are not publicly disclosed.
NRC IRAP agreement 1038022 establishes a C$75,000 feasibility proof of concept, not a successful technical outcome, product readiness, customer or deployment.
DND's C$19.7 million initial DICE value excluding tax and CanadaBuys' C$24,224,260.49 base-page value have different unexplained public bases and are not combined.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed Logistik Unicorp's official 1993 history, managed-program mandate, Canadian contact route and current corporate reporting.
Confirmed the Women's Armour System component split, plate configurations, fit range and no-named-adoption boundary through NP Aerospace.
Confirmed that the former federal corporation continued into Quebec in 2018 rather than treating its federal inactive status as business closure.
Confirmed a granted firefighter-garment patent while excluding commercialization and ceased-family claims from the candidate.
Confirmed DICE amendment 004, its July 30, 2026 date, C$14,097,045 increase, C$41,780,930.95 current total and 2032 term.
Confirmed NRC IRAP agreement 1038022 and its C$75,000 connected-PPE feasibility scope without inferring technical success.
Confirmed DND's current Clothing Online and Combats Online use of Logistik's portal and direct-delivery role.
Confirmed the bilingual CanadaBuys DICE amendment fields; French follow-up added terminology but no different event or scope narrative.
Confirmed Logistik remains in Wynnchurch's January 2026 portfolio materials, but found no public current equity percentages.
Final official-domain sitemap, robots and exact DICE product-document probes produced zero new durable configuration or adoption evidence.

leads.refreshSummary: Logistik Unicorp is proposed to update current activity to the 2026-07-30 CW2397900 amendment, expand operating context and add the Women's Armour System capability, DICE and OCFC2 participations, and the C$75,000 connected-PPE funding event.
